title: $310.2K Per Month eCommerce Business in the Health & Fitness Niche
description:
This business, first acquired by the current owner in January 2023, operates in the Health & Fitness and Sports niches. Since the acquisition, the Seller has rebuilt the company from the ground up, including a complete website redevelopment, replacement of suppliers, vendors, and technology stack, and refinement of the core product lineup. The brand offers weightlifting equipment and accessories inspired by classic, old-school lifting culture, supported by a strong visual identity that resonates with both serious and casual lifters who value performance, durability, and the timeless spirit of traditional strength training. Operating primarily through a Shopify storefront, which generates approximately 80% of revenue, the company also maintains a presence on additional channels, including Amazon FBM, eBay, TikTok, and direct B2B sales to gym owners. The business has delivered sustained 2x year-over-year growth with consistently strong profitability, maintaining net margins above 15%. This performance has been driven by disciplined brand positioning, contribution-positive paid acquisition (with Google Ads representing approximately 7–10% of revenue annually), steady organic traffic growth, and a highly structured inventory and logistics framework supporting efficient multi-warehouse operations and scalable procurement planning.
 
The owner currently dedicates approximately 20 hours per week to the business, with roughly half of that time focused on new product development and internal process improvements. The P&L reflects the cost of replacing most operational responsibilities of the owner, and day-to-day execution is handled by an established team, meaning the time commitment for a new owner would likely be materially lower. The team consists of seven employees: an operations manager, an operations supervisor, two customer support associates, two fulfillment associates, and a carrier support specialist. Products are sourced from three suppliers based in China and shipped directly to third-party logistics warehouses in Los Angeles and Indianapolis, with neither the Seller nor staff physically handling inventory. Overall, this represents a compelling opportunity for buyers seeking a highly optimized fitness brand with strong historical growth, diversified revenue streams across DTC, marketplace, and B2B channels, and meaningful expansion potential through further brand partnerships, logistics optimization, influencer collaborations, and international growth.

Regular responsibilities include providing light customer support, and maintaining occasional social media engagement. Previously, a PPC contractor was used for the business, but they have recently ended this partnership. During peak seasons, periodic email newsletters are sent to the existing Shopify customer base to drive additional sales. Monthly tasks consist of basic accounting and performance reviews.

Overall, the operation is well structured and not founder-time intensive. Most execution is handled through Amazon’s infrastructure and trusted external partners, making this a streamlined and transferable opportunity with proven traction in the German market.

title: $14.8K Per Month Display Advertising Site in the Food & Beverages Niche
description:
Launched in 2009, this Display Advertising site operates in the recipe niche and monetizes primarily through Display Advertising and Affiliate partnerships. With a Semrush Authority Score of 41 and consistent year-over-year revenue growth since 2023, the site benefits from strong domain age, diversified revenue streams, and a streamlined content process supported by a photographer and an MSN publishing partner.

Revenue is diversified across 66.70% Display Advertising via Raptive, 12.98% Display Advertising via MSN Syndication, 13.23% Sponsored Posts, and 7.10% Affiliate income. Traffic is primarily driven by Organic Search (66.34%), followed by Direct (17.12%) and Organic Social, primarily Pinterest (13.67%). The business maintains an email list of 9,200 subscribers hosted on Kit (ConvertKit), built largely through a “print pass” feature that captures emails before recipe downloads. The list generates a 25% open rate and 2% click-through rate, offering additional monetization potential. Content is consistently added, with up to six new posts published per month during busier periods. The seller writes the content using a structured template and trained AI assistance, while a contracted photographer is paid $375 for 12 fully edited high-resolution images and shared rights to the images. An external MSN publishing team manages MSN content distribution under a profit-sharing agreement (20% to the seller). The seller focuses weekly on updating older posts, scheduling emails and Pinterest pins, reviewing MSN content, and conducting monthly keyword research and editorial planning. The business requires approximately 10–15 hours per week to be maintained by the owner.  No paid advertising or link-building services have been used, and the site has not incurred any penalties.

With an established brand, aged domain, diversified monetization, and operational support in place, this business presents a scalable opportunity. Growth avenues include further optimizing Pinterest and social channels, expanding sponsored content partnerships, enhancing email segmentation and automation, and increasing publishing frequency to capitalize on its strong organic search foundation.

*Raptive requires a minimum of 100,000 pageviews per month for the first/main website to be accepted into their program and 30,000 pageviews for additional sites. If the website is already part of the Raptive network and does not meet the traffic requirements, Raptive has been lenient in accepting the transfer of sites already part of the network, provided the buyer is approved and currently has an active Raptive account. If the site’s traffic is below the 100k requirement, please contact Empire Flippers for assistance. Buyers are responsible for checking the site's traffic level before purchasing the listing.

Executive Summary
The target company is a leading agritech firm, founded in 2016, focused on providing market access and financial services to smallholder farmers in a West African country. Through its digital platform, the company connects farmers directly to buyers, eliminating intermediaries and improving pricing transparency. The company’s platform also enables farmers to access financial services such as mobile money and microloans, improving financial inclusion.

The company has grown rapidly and now serves over 350,000 farmers across multiple regions. These farmers primarily cultivate staple crops such as maize, soybeans, and sorghum, benefiting from the company’s services, which have increased their incomes by 35% and reduced food waste by 25%. With strategic partnerships in agriculture, finance, and telecommunications, the company is well-positioned to continue its growth trajectory.
Key Metrics:

 	Farmers Onboarded: 350,000+
 	Regions of Operation: Multiple regions
 	Crops Facilitated: 75,000 metric tons+
 	Financial Transactions Processed: $30M+
 	The sale of the company presents a unique opportunity to acquire a rapidly growing business with established operations, a proven platform, and significant room for expansion in both existing and new markets.

Market Opportunity
The agricultural sector in West Africa is a key economic driver, with smallholder farmers producing the majority of the region’s agricultural output. Despite their importance, farmers face significant challenges in accessing fair market prices, logistical support, and financial services.
Challenges Addressed by the Company:

 	Market Access: Many farmers are forced to sell to middlemen at low prices due to limited access to urban markets.
 	Logistical Constraints: Poor infrastructure and transportation options make it difficult for farmers to move their produce to markets, leading to crop spoilage and lower returns.
 	Financial Exclusion: Smallholder farmers often lack formal financial services, such as credit and insurance, which limits their ability to invest in their farms and increase productivity.

Company’s Solution:
The company’s platform tackles these challenges through an integrated solution that connects farmers directly with buyers, provides logistics support, and offers financial services. This comprehensive approach has made the company a trusted partner for both farmers and buyers, helping to drive significant improvements in farmer income and productivity.
Products and Services
Digital Platform:
The company’s primary product is its digital platform, which connects farmers to buyers and provides essential market information. The platform allows farmers to sell their crops directly to buyers, eliminating intermediaries and ensuring transparent pricing. Additionally, the platform facilitates logistics such as transportation and storage, significantly reducing food spoilage.
Financial Inclusion Platform:
The financial platform enables farmers to access services such as mobile money, loans, and micro-insurance. By leveraging the platform, farmers can build credit histories and gain access to formal financial institutions, empowering them to invest in their farms.
Logistics Platform:
The company offers on-demand logistics services to farmers through its platform, ensuring efficient transportation of crops from farms to buyers or storage facilities. This logistics solution addresses one of the most significant barriers to market access for smallholder farmers.
Franchise Distribution:
The company’s franchise program enables third-party distributors to store and sell crops at local hubs. This model not only provides farmers with additional market access but also reduces food waste by offering immediate storage solutions.
Strategic Partnerships and Competitive Advantage
The company has established key partnerships across multiple sectors, including agriculture, telecommunications, and finance. These partnerships enable the company to expand its reach, enhance its service offerings, and provide additional value to farmers.
Competitive Advantage:
The company differentiates itself from competitors by offering an end-to-end solution that addresses the entire agricultural value chain. Its competitors typically focus on narrow segments of the market, while the company provides a full suite of services,.

title: $53.3K Per Month eCommerce Business in the Art Niche
description:
This is an opportunity to acquire a well-established eCommerce business based in Italy, operating in the custom portrait niche. Founded in September 2020, the brand has built strong market credibility, supported by over 450 Trustpilot reviews with an average rating of 4.4 stars.

The business generates net margins of over 11% and benefits from strong seasonal demand, with approximately 81% of annual revenue concentrated in November and December. During peak season, the Seller hires two temporary staff members who manage order fulfillment and shipping, working full-time from mid-November through December 20. Outside of peak periods, operations are lean and efficient.

Custom artwork production is handled by three experienced graphic designers who create personalized portraits for customers year-round. Inventory is stored and fulfilled from the Seller’s own warehouse, with in-house printing machinery currently used. However, the Seller has confirmed that operations could be easily transitioned to a print-on-demand or 3PL model, significantly reducing operational complexity and fixed overhead.

All core suppliers—including ink, paper, and frames—are located in Italy, ensuring reliable sourcing and quality control. Customer acquisition is driven primarily through Instagram advertising, which has proven highly effective for this visually driven product category.

There is substantial upside for a new owner. Artificial intelligence has not yet been utilized and represents a major opportunity for efficiency gains in design, personalization, and customer experience. Additional growth levers include international expansion into broader European and North American markets, further optimization of paid advertising, transitioning fulfillment to a print-on-demand or 3PL setup, expanding the product catalog, and introducing upsells to increase average order value.

*Inventory is not normally included in the list price, further details can be provided to Unlockers.

Zentaro is a fast-growing, profitable, and highly systemized Dutch fashion ecommerce brand operating in the general apparel niche. Launched in late 2024, the brand has rapidly scaled to over USD $750K in total revenue in its first 12 months and maintains strong profit margins of 32%.  	Advertising Efficiency: Performance Max campaigns yielding profitable ROAS with strong CTRs and a clean Google Ads account structure.
 	Email List: 14,000+ subscribers with consistent email engagement and 0.0% refund rate, reflecting both product satisfaction and strong brand trust.

Key Business Highlights

title: Virtual Reality Blog
description:
VR Heaven is a passion project started by someone who believes VR will be the future (and still does). Most the traffic from search and revenue from ads and affiliate sales (Amazon mostly). It also has many strong organic backlinks including Namecheap, Fiverr, The Telegraph, Bigcommerce and more. However, due to growing committments from my other projects, I'm ready to hand this project to a new owner. The site peaked in December 2022, which was when it got accepted into Mediavine (70k monthly visits), but it hasn't been updated in a few years and the traffic has tanked. The site still has age, authority, trust and a strong foundation to rebuild. In the right hands, there is a ton of upside potential, especially in an industry that can take off really quick like VR. For example, whenever Meta releases a new headset, there is a big traffic spike

What is VR Heaven?
VR Heaven isn't your standard churn and burn affiliate site, that was made for a quick flip. Everything was made with love and care over 6 years. It's a real brand & business with long-term upside.

VRHeaven.io is a blog I started back in 2019 as a passionate project, right around the early days of consumer VR (Quest 1 era).

I started this website because I genuinely loved VR, was absolutely hooked and mindblown by it. I truly believed VR to be the future (and still do - it's just happened slower than expected). 😄

My goal was to publish helpful, no-BS guides about VR, which I mostly wrote myself - not AI (AI wasn't even available back then). There were also a few freelance writers who contributed too.

Although I did receive a handful of backlinks from my outreach efforts, most of the backlinks are 100% organic, linking to our studies and useful guides ✅
Authority and Backlinks
The site has strong domain-level trust and a natural backlink profile:

 	DR: 43
 	Backlinks: 1,500+
 	Referring domains: 709

Examples of top backlinks:

 	The Telegraph: https://www.telegraph.co.uk/technology/2021/03/11/racist-sexist-gadgets-targeted-new-product-safety-rules/
 	Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/resources/guides/graphic-design/midjourney-use-cases
 	Namecheap: https://www.namecheap.com/blog/gaming-servers/
 	GamesBeat (formerly Venturebeat): https://gamesbeat.com/a-survey-about-vr-sickness-and-gender/
 	The Epoch Times: https://www.theepochtimes.com/us/facebook-in-race-against-time-to-turn-metaverse-into-success-4898995
 	BigCommerce: https://www.bigcommerce.com/articles/ecommerce/virtual-reality-ecommerce/
 	Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtual_reality_sickness
 	And plenty more DR 70+ links
 	This backlink profile would cost tens of thousands of dollars to replicate.

Design Note: I'm currently using the website as a placeholder landing page for my game. See how the blog used to look here:

https://web.archive.org/web/20230314001018/https://vrheaven.io/ (this can be reverted easily)

Current articles library: https://vrheaven.io/author/vr-heaven/

See the types of content we post there.

Topics covered: AR/VR, AI, Gaming, Computers, Hardware, Accessories & Gadgets
Revenue & Traffic

 	$350/month revenue - no operational costs other than domain + hosting
 	Total Revenue in 2025: $4200.18
 	Revenue comes from Mediavine Ads (35%) and Affiliate Sales (65%) - mostly Amazon
 	67k traffic in the past 12 months (5.6k per month)
 	Most traffic is from tier 1 countries: US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany

Why I'm Selling
Nowadays, I'm a full-time developer making the game of my dreams (which will potentially be getting a VR port down the line).

Unfortunately, I have absolutely zero time to work on this website anymore and I'm ready to hand it over to a new owner who can give it the attention it deserves.

Before buying, you should note that the website hasn't been updated in a few years and the traffic is on the decline each year (starting from 2023).

With that said - thanks to our age, authority, and trust - there is a strong foundation to rebuild and grow.

A site like this has a ton of upside potential, because it is lacking on the content side, rather than the domain authority/backlink side. And being in an industry like VR, things can take off overnight.

We see big spikes in traffic whenever a new headset gets announced, or when Meta announces a sale.
Potential for Growth

 	Update existing articles
 	Update broken/outdated Amazon affiliate links
 	Capitalize on upcoming new VR headset announcements. The Quest 4 release is the big one - which will be coming late 2026 or 2027
 	Build content clusters, in which the site is currently lacking
 	Sell your own products (ideal) - there is huge upside if you can turn this site into a business, rather than a content blog. VR accessories such as comfort straps, decals, and 3D-printed gadgets are wildly popular
 	Branch more into AI and AR. Although we've got a few articles on these topics, there is a lot of room for growth

Summary
Upsides:

 	High DR: Many strong backlinks worth tens of thousands of dollars alone
 	A real blog made with love, not AI or churn & burn
 	Aged domain - 6 years old
 	$350/month revenue - no operation expenses other than domain + hosting
 	Futuristic niche with huge growth potential
 	Plenty of room for content updates, improvements and new articles

Downsides:

 	Blog hasn't been updated in a few years
 	Many articles with outdated information
 	Many outdated/broken Amazon links
 	Traffic has been on the decline due to this

Ready to Invest in the Future?
Minimum Offer: $8,000

(We received valuations between $8,000 and 13,000 - so this is on the low end). I'm hoping for more because of our strong backlink profile, but since this money will greatly help with the development of my other project, I'll accept what is of.

All roles are remote-friendly and come with flexible terms. Details are discussed privately.
Growth Opportunities

Flexible financing is available directly from the current owner. This option is designed to support qualified buyers and ease the transition into ownership.

title: Amazon FBA Fitness Equipment Brand
description:
Established Amazon FBA fitness brand with a 20+ year proven reputation, offering patented and trademarked premium resistance bands and suspension trainers. The business includes approximately $100K USD in retail-value inventory, ready for immediate sales, and presents strong growth and scalability opportunities

Business Overview
Astone Fitness Ltd. is a long-established Canadian fitness eCommerce company with over 20 years in the market, known for its patented and trademarked product lines: Ripcords® and The Human Trainer®. Operating globally through Amazon FBA, DTC eCommerce, and wholesale channels, the business has generated over $500,000 in historical annual revenues and continues to offer valuable IP, brand equity, and turnkey infrastructure. While the current owner has intentionally scaled down operations due to personal relocation and time constraints, the business remains a highly defensible, scalable asset ready for reactivation and growth.
Key Financials (Trailing Twelve Months ending December 2025)

 	Revenue: USD $34,663.06
 	Profit: USD $911.13
 	Monthly Revenue: USD $2,800 (avg)
 	Peak Revenue Month: October 2025 — USD $9,624
 	Inventory Value: USD $30,000 (excluded from list price, negotiable)

Product Portfolio & Intellectual Property

 	Astone Fitness owns two flagship product lines, both supported by a robust IP portfolio:
 	Ripcords® Resistance Bands
 	Trademarked in the U.S. and Canada with 20+ years of brand presence. Ripcords® are widely recognized, with historical popularity among fitness professionals, military clients, and home users.

The Human Trainer® Suspension System
Protected by a U.S. utility patent covering its dual anchor design. This product provides unique value within the suspension training market and is trademarked in the U.S., giving the brand a legally protected advantage.

Both product lines include optimized Amazon listings, custom packaging, and branded visual assets. Their associated intellectual property — including trademarks and a U.S. patent — is included in the sale.
Operations
The business is built for operational efficiency. Fulfillment is handled by Amazon FBA, while the DTC website runs on WooCommerce. Seller involvement is minimal and mainly limited to stock oversight and supplier coordination. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), supplier contracts, and platform integrations (e.g., Amazon, eBay, PayPal) are in place for seamless ownership transfer.
Digital Assets & Online Presence
The asset package includes a valuable domain portfolio, product visuals, and an engaged email list:
Social Media Presence:

 	Facebook – 1,500 followers
 	Instagram – 938 followers
 	X (Twitter) – 2,645 followers
 	YouTube – 697 subscribers
 	Email Subscribers – 20,000+

Domains (Included in Sale):

 	Core: thehumantrainer.com, ripcords.com, ripcords.co.uk
 	Supplementary: exercisecords.com, flexcords.com, pricepointfitness.ca/.com

These domains provide an SEO advantage, international expansion support, and brand protection.
Digital Assets:
Includes all media (images, videos, product graphics), 21 professional fitness eBooks, and marketing files housed in Dropbox.
Revenue Breakdown & Historical Performance
While revenue was intentionally paused in recent years, historical P&L data shows consistent multi-channel performance. Notably, in October 2025, a reactivation of wholesale efforts drove nearly $10K in revenue. Similarly, spikes in March and June indicate the business responds positively to even modest sales effort.
Sales Channels

 	Amazon FBA – Core revenue channel, across U.S. and Canada marketplaces
 	Direct E-commerce – www.thehumantrainer.com, supporting higher-margin sales
 	Wholesale – Established client list including gyms, trainers, and retail outlets in North America
 	eBay and Walmart accounts included

Assets Included in Sale

 	All brand trademarks (Ripcords®, The Human Trainer®)
 	One U.S. patent for suspension system
 	Amazon and e-commerce seller accounts
 	Complete digital media library
 	Domain portfolio (including ripcords.com and thehumantrainer.com)
Customer and wholesale email lists
 	Three months of post-sale transition support

Growth Opportunities

 	Marketing Reactivation: SEO, PPC, social, and influencer campaigns have been dormant but previously effective
 	Wholesale Relaunch: Strong B2B contacts exist and can be re-engaged
 	Product Expansion: Opportunities to introduce new lines or accessories under existing brands
 	International Expansion: Leveraging .co.uk domains for UK/EU growth
 	Licensing Potential: Monetize patents and trademarks through licensing deals

Why Acquire This Business?
This is a rare opportunity to acquire a globally recognized fitness brands with strong IP protection, minimal operational requirements, and proven market demand. The asset base — including domains, IP, and digital content — offers substantial built-in value. With renewed focus, a buyer can revive the business to its historical revenue levels and beyond. Whether you’re an investor, fitness entrepreneur, or Amazon operator, Astone Fitness Ltd. represents a turnkey, brand-driven growth opportunity..

title: Windows Software Download Site
description:
Established 2012 multilingual Windows software downloads site + 2 YouTube tutorial channels. Custom code. Affiliate-driven revenue with news & guides

Overview



Established in 2012, our site is a multilingual (5+ languages) Windows-software platform combining download pages, news, and step-by-step tutorials, plus two YouTube channels focused on software how-tos. The site runs on a custom CMS optimized for speed and clean internal linking.



How it makes money



Primary monetization is affiliate programs on high-intent download pages, complemented by YouTube ads and website AdSense. Ad inventory on the site is intentionally light—only one ad block on the download section—leaving clear room to expand placements without harming UX.



Traffic



Traffic to both the website and channels is 100% organic (Search, Suggested, Browse). Multilingual content captures long-tail queries across multiple locales; video descriptions, cards, and end screens link back to relevant download/tutorial pages, creating a recurring loop between YouTube and the site.



Operations



Runs on a single-panel custom CMS to manage software entries (versions/download buttons/affiliate IDs), news, tutorials, translations, SEO fields, and internal linking. The YouTube channels are managed in YouTube Studio. Transfer includes CMS admin access, codebase + database export, and Brand Account transfer for both channels.



Unique situation (read before inquiring)



Since 2018, the property has experienced negative SEO activity aimed at the current owner. The strongest pressure has been on the YouTube channels, which nevertheless remain in good standing and continue to earn organically. The sale thesis: a change of ownership removes the personal trigger, improving the odds of recovery across the site and channels. Combined with broader ad placements and refreshed content, the upside can be significant.



Why it’s attractive to contrarian buyers




Catalyst: ownership change expected to de-escalate attacks.



Operational leverage: straightforward to run; clear on-page monetization opportunities (in-content/anchor ads, broader affiliate coverage).



Multilingual footprint: diversified traffic across locales and evergreen software topics.




Risks & mitigations




The negative SEO could persist post-sale; buyer should be comfortable with risk and maintain disavow/link and video monitoring.



Standard platform risks (algorithm updates, affiliate program changes) are mitigated by diversified channels (affiliates, AdSense, YouTube).




Scenario analysis (for expectation-setting, not a guarantee)




Outcome A (Recovery): Ownership change + standard hygiene → rankings/visibility normalize; expanding ad placements and refreshing top assets yields material uplift.



Outcome B (Strategic exit): A third party expresses purchase interest from the new owner; buyer may elect to flip/sell depending on market conditions.



Outcome C (Adverse): Attacks persist and recovery is limited; buyer operates the asset conservatively with focus on cashflow and selective content updates..

Home Seller USA is a 28-year-old, premium online real estate brand with a rich legacy in the U.S. housing market. It began in 1997 as a traditional property listing platform, transitioned into a rental property marketplace, and has now evolved into a high-ticket eCommerce store selling prefabricated homes.



The business has pivoted with the times, retaining the credibility of its long-established domain while leveraging modern eCommerce to serve a growing niche: affordable yet high-quality prefab homes manufactured overseas and delivered to U.S. buyers.



This is a business with a clear, proven process. It requires minimal owner time (less than one hour per week) yet has the potential for substantial profits, with each order capable of generating $5,000 to $15,000 in profit.



Products & Market Position



The site offers a curated range of standard prefab house designs sourced via a U.S.-based partner.
The U.S. partner works directly with trusted manufacturing facilities that specialize in high-quality modular housing.




Design Philosophy: We offer tested, market-ready designs that appeal to buyers seeking affordable yet stylish housing options.



Customization Policy: Customization is deliberately kept light to ensure manufacturing efficiency and avoid delays. Requests typically include:

Additional cabinets in the kitchen



Minor storage modifications



Finishing or color preferences






Fulfillment & Operations



Note: Structural elements such as bedroom count, house size, and core room positioning (kitchen, bathroom, etc.) remain standard to ensure consistent quality and predictable delivery timelines.



Every home is made-to-order. We carry no inventory, keeping overhead extremely low.
The process from inquiry to delivery is structured and repeatable:



Step 1 – Customer Inquiry




A prospective buyer reaches out via the website, often with a preferred house size and bedroom count in mind.



I personally review all incoming queries to ensure we capture the exact needs.




Step 2 – Minor Customization (If Requested)




Small adjustments (e.g., cabinet layout, storage space) are noted.



All customization requests are confirmed as feasible with our U.S. partner before being presented to the buyer.




Step 3 – Customer Approval




The final proposal, including any agreed modifications, is sent to the buyer for approval.




Step 4 – Payment Processing




Payment is taken in full upfront, ensuring cash flow is secure before manufacturing begins.




Step 5 – Manufacturing & Logistics




Our U.S. partner oversees the manufacturing process with their Chinese partners.



They handle all aspects of production, quality control, international shipping, and customs clearance.



Typical delivery time: 6–8 weeks from order confirmation.




Step 6 – Delivery




The completed home is delivered directly to the buyer’s location.




Operational Requirements



This is a low-touch business model:




Owner Time Commitment: Under 1 hour/week.



Main Task: Clear and thorough communication with customers before finalizing orders.



No Inventory: All products are made-to-order, eliminating storage costs.



Supplier Management: One U.S. partner handles both production and logistics.



Tools Used: Stripe for payment processing, email for customer communication, and our affiliate platform (included in sale) for partner management.




Why This Business Stands Out




28-Year Legacy: Established domain and trust in the housing niche.



High Margins: $5,000–$15,000 profit potential per sale.



Minimal Time Commitment: Designed for a hands-off owner or investor.



Zero Inventory Risk: Made-to-order model keeps costs low.



Fully Developed Supply Chain: Reliable U.S. partner and manufacturing setup in place.



Scalable Marketing: Early-stage affiliate program ready for growth.




Reason for Sale



The sole reason for selling is declining health, which no longer allows me to personally oversee even the light operational involvement required. This is not a distressed sale. It is a strategic transfer to a new owner capable of maximizing the business’s high-ticket potential.



Post-Sale Transition & Support



To ensure a smooth takeover, I will provide:




30 days of post-sale support covering operations, customer communication, and order flow.



Direct introductions to our U.S. partner.



Full transfer of the affiliate program platform and login credentials.



Detailed training on handling customization requests, customer expectations, and payment processes.




Home Seller USA is a rare opportunity to acquire a premium, high-ticket online housing business with minimal operational overhead and robust supplier relationships. With its established brand credibility, lucrative profit margins, and early-stage affiliate program, it’s positioned for significant growth under a capable new owner. This is an investment-grade acquisition, low time requirement, high reward po.

High Growth Historical Sustainability-Focused Notebooks eCommerce Brand doing $1.9M sales/year from diversified revenue channels!

Business Start Date: 2016

Executive Summary




The business is a premium eco-conscious stationery brand committed to sustainability, ethical production, and superior craftsmanship. The company specializes in high-quality, 100% vegan notebooks and journals that offer an unparalleled writing experience.





Founded in 2016, the business has grown rapidly, experiencing a 304% five-year growth and achieving a valuation of $9.5 million. The brand has earned the prestigious EU V-Label certification and Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) approval, reinforcing its commitment to environmental responsibility.





With global distribution via its website, Amazon, and specialty retailers, the business has positioned itself as a market leader in sustainable stationery. The brand also donates 2% of its proceeds to the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) UK, underscoring its dedication to conservation.





The business is at an exciting turning point, presenting a unique opportunity for strategic buyers looking to acquire a pioneering brand in the premium sustainable stationery market. As the world’s first and only fully vegan-certified notebook brand, the business has built a strong reputation for craftsmanship, eco-conscious innovation, and a loyal, engaged community. With the rising demand for sustainable, high-quality stationery, the brand is uniquely positioned for global expansion.





With a strong commitment to sustainability, the company offers a diverse range of products that cater to environmentally conscious consumers. Its combination of FSC-certified materials, biodegradable components, and meticulous design has made it a preferred choice for creatives, professionals, and journalists. The business has demonstrated consistent revenue growth, strong retail partnerships, and a thriving direct-to-consumer model, making it an attractive asset for investors seeking a purpose-driven brand with long-term market potential.





This is a rare opportunity to scale an established, values-driven business with a clear competitive edge in the sustainability space. We are currently evaluating offers from select partners who align with our vision and can bring the operational scale and resources to propel the business into its next phase of growth.




Business Overview



History and Mission




The business was founded by a Forbes “Thirty Under Thirty” honoree, who comes from a long lineage of paper manufacturers dating back over 200 years. The company was started as a side project while he was working at Rolls-Royce Aerospace but quickly became a full-fledged business.





The business aims to revolutionize the stationery industry by offering environmentally friendly, ethically sourced, and superior-quality writing products that do not compromise on luxury. The brand operates on a strong sustainability ethos, ensuring that its materials and processes have minimal environmental impact.




Location




The business operates primarily as an e-commerce business, shipping products worldwide. It has established partnerships with major retailers across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Europe, and Asia.




Vision




The company envisions becoming the leading global brand in sustainable stationery, inspiring consumers to make eco-friendly choices without sacrificing quality.




Sustainability Commitments




The business is dedicated to reducing its environmental impact through various sustainability initiatives:





 	

 	100% Vegan Certification: The first and only notebook brand with EU V-Label certification.







 	

 	FSC-Approved Paper: Ensures responsible sourcing of materials.







 	

 	Zero Animal-Based Products: No animal-derived adhesives or materials used in production..

The trademarked brand offers a unique accessory for digital cameras (patent pending), designed to help photographers capture nostalgic and vintage aesthetics. This distinctive product has received a strong reaction, earning mentions on YouTube and within enthusiast communities on Reddit. The business benefits from excellent profit margins of around 30%, with the product's partially self-assembled nature allowing for a low working capital tied to inventory and a fast turnover rate.
 
The business operates exclusively through its Shopify store, with the majority of sales originating from the United States (73%), followed by the United Kingdom (5%) and Canada (4%). The product's components are sourced from two suppliers in China, while the final assembly and 3D printing are performed by a lean team of 2 employees at a warehouse in California. The Seller dedicates approximately 3 hours per week to the business, mainly communicating with employees.

* Inventory is not normally included in the list price; further details can be provided to Unlockers.
